describes: The vertex and per-instance channels every mesh and instance carries (decisions §5, docs/building-blocks.md 'What a part carries'). Meshes at L0 to L2 are written through MeshData in the player, so the layout is ours; library parts cross FBX with a sidecar naming each UV set's channel. tools/validate_record.py checks that each layout's bytes add up. Byte widths are provisional until the gully's A/B at 3.2.

slots.content: the address into its page group's maps. A piece's bare year and variation are the piece table's, never the vertex's (step 3)
the mark coordinate, continuous along a run (the brush)

the piece index in its chunk's piece table (its clocks, age, variation and flags: chunk-format.md, section 4); the edge distance in tenths of a millimetre, which with the face kind gives the hands' reach (layers.json, lichen)

notes.hollow-rate: reserved: walked stone writes 0, since its dish is h1.r times the thing's wear rate (layers.json, derived); a material that dishes without polishing writes it

slots.content: the rest or undisplaced position, for deforming and wind-moved parts. Stone writes none: its moss and held water moved to h1.b and the derived hollow at step 3 (layers.json)

shell.note: Ids are constant over each triangle: vertices split where an id changes, and the shader reads them without interpolation.

slots.content: the address in its cell's shell atlas

tangent.rule: Each shader derives the frame per pixel from the screen derivatives of the UV set its normal detail lives in: uv1 for the bent normal, the maps' relief and the shell's normal atlas; uv0 for a material's grain normal.

reserved.when: the gully's A/B at L2 and on shells shows coarse triangles facet

fields.note: chunk at l0 and l1, cell at l2 and l3, block at l4, a kit instance
uv3's piece index, a shell's thing index, or the cell's facts buffer index, 65,536; a unit with more takes a second slot
